import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def blocks(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seps_r=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1]
    seps_c=[j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    def ranges(seps,n):
        rs=[];s=0
        for x in seps: rs.append((s,x-1)); s=x+1
        rs.append((s,n-1)); return rs
    rr=ranges(seps_r,h); cc=ranges(seps_c,w)
    out=[]
    for i0,i1 in rr:
        row=[]
        for j0,j1 in cc:
            cnt=sum(1 for i in range(i0,i1+1) for j in range(j0,j1+1) if g[i][j] not in (0,) and (i,j) not in [(i,x) for x in seps_r] )
            # count non-bg non-sep
            row.append((i0,i1,j0,j1))
        out.append(row)
    return seps_r,seps_c,rr,cc
for k in ['Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 2 input','Test input']:
    g=G[k]
    sr,sc,rr,cc=blocks(g)
    print(k,'seps',sr,sc)
    from collections import Counter
    vals=[v for r in g for v in r]
    bg=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for i0,i1 in rr:
        counts=[]
        for j0,j1 in cc:
            c=sum(1 for i in range(i0,i1+1) for j in range(j0,j1+1) if g[i][j] not in (bg,) and i not in sr and j not in sc)
            counts.append(c)
        print(counts)
print('demo1 out',G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print('demo2 out',G['Demo pair 2 output'])
